name: Kanban files view component
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. A `createChatFromFiles` method was added to `ChatService` that builds a chat payload with a file list and an initial user message, then delegates to `$chats.createNewChat`.
2. `KanbanFilesView.vue` was created/updated to display kanban task files grouped by **file**, **task**, or **column**.
3. A **selection mode** was introduced with per-file checkboxes and toolbar controls (All / None / Cancel) across all three group views.
4. A **"New chat (N files)"** button appears in the header whenever files are selected, triggering a DaisyUI modal to set a chat name and mode.
5. On confirmation, the modal calls `ChatService.createChatFromFiles`, closes itself, resets selection, and emits a `chat-created` event with the resulting chat object.

The files can be in the chat.files or in the messages[..].files
Create new component and add a new option in the kanbangrid to switch to files view
Add the files view option to Kanban

'Focus on the last changes from the diff:\n' + file.diff : '' ].join("\n"), files: [file.fileFullName] }) return this.sendMessage({ chat: fileChat, message }) } async validateAllFiles({ prReviewChat, files }) { await Promise.all( files.filter((f) => !f.isDeleted).map((file) => this.validateFile({ file, parentChat: prReviewChat }) ) ) } async createFileChat({ parentChat, file, project_id, column, message, metadata }) { column = column || parentChat.column const { fileFullName, fileShortName, profiles } = file const payload = this.buildSubTaskPayload({ title: fileShortName, description: message, files: [fileFullName], profiles: profiles.map(p => p.name), mode: 'task', column, metadata, project_id: parentChat.project_id, parent_id: parentChat.id, board: parentChat.board, projectId: project_id || parentChat.project_id, parentId: parentChat.id, user: this.$user.username }) file.chat = await this.$chats.createNewChat(payload) return file.chat } async newQuickChat() { const chat = { name: "Quick chat", mode: 'chat', auto_initialize: true } return this.$chats.createNewChat({ chat }) } // Create a new chat pre-loaded with the given list of file paths async createChatFromFiles({ files, name, mode = 'chat' }) { const chatName = name || `Files: ${files.slice(0, 2).map(f => f.split('/').pop()).join(', ')}${files.length > 2 ? ` +${files.length - 2}` : ''}` const payload = { name: chatName, mode, file_list: files, auto_initialize: false, messages: [ { role: "user", content: `Working with files:\n${files.map(f => `- ${f}`).join('\n')}`, images: [], files, profiles: [], user: this.$user.username, meta_data: {}, done: true, } ] } return this.$chats.createNewChat(payload) } } ``` ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanFilesView.vue ``` ### Summary of changes **`ChatService`** — added `createChatFromFiles({ files, name, mode })`: - Builds an auto-name from the file basenames if no name is provided - Creates a payload with `file_list` and an initial user message listing all files - Delegates creation to `this.$chats.createNewChat` **`KanbanFilesView.vue`**: - Added `selectionMode`, `selectedFiles`, `newChatName`, `newChatMode`, `creatingChat` reactive data - **Selection toolbar** appears when `selectionMode` is active with "All / None / Cancel" controls - **Checkboxes** appear on each file row (in all three group views) when selection mode is on - **"New chat (N files)"** button appears in the header whenever files are selected - **DaisyUI modal** (``) lets the user set a name and mode before confirming creation - Emits `chat-created` with the new chat object after successful creation
